fullDescription: A modern health-tech and AI dashboard style featuring a warm red and orange color palette, 'Plus Jakarta Sans' typography, and a soft, clean glassmorphism-inspired aesthetic. The design uses rounded containers (up to 40px), subtle gradients, and a clear sidebar-to-content hierarchy. Suitable for medical SaaS, fitness tracking, fintech, and personalized AI assistants where trust and clarity are paramount. Highlights include bento-grid suggested actions, a pill-shaped bottom-anchored input bar, and high-contrast status tags.
prompt:
## Resumo
CardioSync is a heart-health focused chatbot interface utilizing a soft-red primary theme with a sidebar-based layout, floating action cards, and a robust input area designed for desktop and mobile accessibility.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using the following specs: Font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans'; Primary Color: Red #ef4444; Secondary: Orange #f97316; Surface: White #ffffff; Background: Linear-gradient(135deg, #fdfcfb 0%, #e2d1c3 100%); Sidebar: #F9F9F9. Typography hierarchy: H1 at 64px bold (tracking-tight), Nav items at 14px medium, Captions at 10px bold uppercase. Borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) with backdrop-filter: blur(10px). Corners: Extra large (40px) for parent containers, 28px for input bars, 12px for small cards. Shadows: 2xl for main containers, lg for buttons. Animation: Cubic-bezier fadeIn (0.6s) with 10px translateY.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sidebar
Width: 288px. Background: #F9F9F9. Elements: A logo section featuring a 40x40px red (#ef4444) icon container with rounded corners (12px); A search input with 10px padding and gray border; Navigation list with icons (size 18px) and 14px medium weight text; A 'Recent Chats' section with truncated text links; A bottom 'Upgrade Card' using a red-to-orange gradient border and a centered 'PRO' badge.

### Top Header
Height: 64px. Padding: 24px horizontal. Features: A breadcrumb/version tag using a pill-shape (bg: #f9fafb, border: #f3f4f6); User profile section on the right with a 40x40px circular avatar and double-layered text (Name: 14px bold, Email: 10px gray).

### Hero Chat Section
Central alignment. H1 title with a text gradient (#ef4444 to #f97316) for emphasis. Grid: 3-column layout (bento style) for suggested prompts. Each card: 20px padding, bg-gradient-to-br, 30px rounded corners, 40x40px icon container that changes color on hover. Text: 14px bold title and 12px leading-relaxed description.

### Input Footer
Max-width: 896px (4xl). Fixed at bottom. Shape: Pill (radius 28px). Background: #f9fafb. Border: #e5e7eb. Elements: Left-aligned text input; Right-aligned action group containing attachment/mic icons and a 40x40px black circular 'send' button that turns red (#ef4444) on hover. Include a sub-text disclaimer at 11px gray.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Suggested Action Cards — Interactive cards that highlight primary user actions with distinct color themes.
Implementation: Card component with 24px padding and a border radius of 30px. Use individual background gradients (e.g., Purple-50 to White). Top-left icon container (40x40px) with background matching the theme. On hover: shadow-xl and -4px translateY. Title text: 14px bold #1e293b. Description text: 12px #64748b.

### Pro Upgrade Widget — Sidebar promotional component with a high-contrast badge.
Container: 16px padding, bg-gradient from #fef2f2 to #fff7ed, border #fee2e2. Badge: 'PRO' in 10px bold white on red #ef4444 background. Button: 12px bold red #ef4444 text on white background, transitioning to full red with white text on hover.

## Notas Especiais
MUST use Plus Jakarta Sans for all text to maintain the clean look. MUST NOT use hard black (#000000); use Slate-800 (#1e293b) for text. All interactive elements MUST have a transition duration of at least 200ms. Corner radii MUST be consistent (40px for large, 12px for small).

style.description: The style is characterized by a mix of 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (weights 300-700), a primary red-to-orange gradient (#ef4444 to #f97316), and a background of soft off-white gradients. It employs rounded corners (40px for main containers, 28px for inputs), 10px backdrop blurs (glassmorphism), and subtle 1px borders with 20% opacity. Animations are gentle, primarily using a 0.6s fadeIn with a 10px vertical shift.
